decisions.reason: Requesting editorial review of the cover does not change the required back matter or author copy.
KDP upload assistance is independently introduced by another clause in the same message and is already represented; it is not a propagated effect of the cover-review modification.
Editorial review of the paperback cover does not alter the interior layout, publication format, or trim size.
The source requests review of the cover specifically and does not change the independently established requirements for chapter illustrations.
The cover-review request does not affect table-of-contents page numbering or its update timing.
The source does not mention or alter the copyright-page publisher line or layout.
Editorial review of the cover does not change Chapter 12 heading hierarchy or capitalization.
The source concerns the external cover and does not resolve or modify the ambiguous interior title-page layout.
A request for editorial review of the cover does not change the manuscript copyediting goal or approved passages.
The cover-review request does not affect the interior book-title newline-artifact constraint.
